# BHG Safety Partners

> BHG Safety Partners is a professional safety consulting and compliance firm headquartered in Hannibal, MO, serving businesses across Missouri, Illinois, and the greater Midwest.

## Mission

We protect workforces and businesses by delivering expert, hands-on OSHA compliance, safety training, and risk management solutions tailored to each client's industry and daily operations. Our goal is simple: keep your people safe and your business compliant.

## Contact Information

- **Phone:** (573) 822-6448
- **Headquarters:** Hannibal, MO
- **Service Area:** Missouri, Illinois, and surrounding Midwest states
- **Website:** https://www.bhgsafetypartners.com

## Core Services

- **Safety Consulting** — Expert OSHA guidance, hazard identification, and risk-reduction strategies custom-fit to your operations.
- **Workplace Safety Training** — Hands-on and classroom instruction covering equipment operation, hazard communication, confined space entry, forklift certification, First Aid/CPR, and more — delivered onsite or virtually.
- **Onsite Safety Inspections** — Thorough facility and job-site walk-throughs that produce priority-rated, actionable written reports.
- **Compliance Audits** — In-depth OSHA and regulatory audits with risk-rated findings and a clear remediation roadmap.
- **Safety Program Development** — Custom-built written safety programs, policies, and procedures (Hazcom, LOTO, emergency action plans) built to OSHA standards.
- **Trusted Safety Partner** — Ongoing, embedded safety support that scales with your operations — inspections, training refreshers, incident investigation, and strategic planning without the overhead of a full-time hire.

## Who We Serve

Construction, manufacturing, oil & gas, and general industry employers of all sizes who need credible, experienced safety professionals without the cost of a full-time department.

## Key Differentiators

- Decades of combined field experience — real-world, not just theory
- No long-term contracts required
- Programs delivered where you work: onsite, at your facility, or virtually
- Bilingual-capable training delivery available
